en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

about the treasure, ‘How much (is due) regarding it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one-fifth’. And (I asked) about the mines, ‘How much (is due) regarding it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one-fifth; and similar to that are the lead, and the zinc, and the iron, and everything what was in the mine there would be taken from it what would be taken from the gold and the silver’.
